A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same SAM implicit-bias study. The main text, equations, figures, and complete Appendices A–E support reliable comparison after matching pagination shifts.

before.justification: v1 reports original optimization simulations and CNN/Grad-CAM experiments, including MNIST, SVHN, and CIFAR-10 results in Section 5 and Appendices C.6, D.8, and E.

after.justification: v2 retains these original simulation and real-data experimental outcomes, including the appendix results.

M1.justification: The SAM perturbations, discrete updates, continuous and rescaled flows, objectives, and model architectures remain unchanged. The added rescaling explanation does not alter the procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions retain single-example and Gaussian-cluster classification, synthetic matrix and frequency-band tasks, and MNIST, SVHN, and CIFAR-10 evaluations. No dataset or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: The corresponding experiments retain the same GD/GF and SAM-variant comparisons. The newly cited papers do not introduce evaluated comparison methods.

E3.justification: Section 4.2.1 corrects the reported heatmap index from argmin_j β_j(t) to argmax_j β_j(t), matching Figure 3a's existing definition. This changes the stated metric description without establishing a rerun; other settings remain unchanged, and Appendix D.8 still says argmin.

E4.justification: The initialization, depth, random-initialization, discrete-versus-continuous, multi-point, and Grad-CAM analyses in Appendices C.6, D.8, and E are retained without additional analyses or evidence.

E5.justification: Appendix E.2 retains the same Seed 0 and Seed 1 examples. No repeated-run information, uncertainty-reporting practice, or statistical testing procedure is added or revised.

E6.justification: The corresponding plots and reported numerical and qualitative outcomes are unchanged, including sequential feature amplification, loss plateaus, and Grad-CAM feature emphasis. The index-description correction does not change the displayed results.

T1.justification: Section 4.2.1 corrects the mathematical definition of j† from an argmin to an argmax, resolving its disagreement with Figure 3a locally. The assumptions, theorems, and proofs remain unchanged; Appendix D.4 only clarifies the existing positive rescaling relationship.

C1.justification: Section 1.1 adds that the finite-time bias offers a possible theoretical perspective on observations that SAM captures atypical subpatterns more effectively than GD. The principal depth-dependent and sequential-amplification claims remain unchanged.

C2.justification: Appendix A.2.3 newly suggests that discovering informative non-majority features may partly explain SAM's improved generalization. This is a qualified mechanistic interpretation linked to prior observations, without additional experimental validation.

D1.justification: The implementation and reproducibility disclosures retain the same initialization schemes, Euler approximations, hyperparameters, training budgets, and dataset-subset descriptions. Code and data access information is unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds Chang and Khanna (2026) and Kim et al. (2026). Kim et al. is connected to the contribution summary and Appendix A.2.3's interpretation of atypical-feature learning, providing a limited positioning extension.

P1.justification: v2 condenses related-work prose, corrects ℓ∞-SAM to ℓ2-SAM in the discussion of Theorem D.1, fixes grammar and heading typos, and adds a short rescaling explanation. The overall section structure remains intact.

P2.justification: The figures retain their content, axes, and captions. Local text and bibliography reflow changes placement, notably shifting Figures 7–8 downward and spilling Appendix A.5's final lines onto the otherwise nearly empty page 22 in v2.

improvement.justification: v2 improves clarity by correcting the SAM-variant reference in Section 4.1, fixing the dominant-index formula in Section 4.2.1, and clarifying flow rescaling in Appendix D.4. These are limited consistency gains: Appendix D.8 still retains argmin, and the proofs and empirical evidence remain unchanged.
